mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.request_redacted_json, '$.path')) FROM tool_call t JOIN agent_run r ON r.enterprise_id = t.enterprise_id AND r.id = t.run_id WHERE t.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND t.actor_user_id = #{user} AND r.user_id = #{user} AND r.conversation_id = #{conversation} AND t.resource_kind IN ('agent', 'workflow') AND t.tool_name IN ('write_file', 'edit_file') AND t.status = 'succeeded' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.result_redacted_json, '$.workspaceVersion')) = 'STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.request_redacted_json, '$.path')) = 'STRING'
